remarks: Welcome to the Sunset-Silverlake Lofts, located in the heart of Silver Lake's Sunset Junction! This beautiful light-filled loft style condo features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, high ceilings, polished concrete floors and tall steel-framed windows. Enter through the front door in the courtyard to find 2 bedrooms and the main bathroom upstairs. Head downstairs into the open concept living area, which includes an updated kitchen, spacious living room, dining room, and the additional half bathroom. Off the living room is the enclosed private patio, perfect for summer BBQ's and al-fresco dining! Tandem parking for 2 cars and an electric car charger located in the gated underground parking area.
